message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of panicking, I decided to embrace the moment. I pulled out my trusty lantern and some flashlights, and we turned the living room into a cozy little hideaway. We played board games by the soft glow of the lights and even made a snack out of whatever we could find in the fridge before it got too warm. It reminded me how easy it is to turn an unexpected situation into a fun family night. Have you ever found joy in a little chaos?
